demo.title: lorg-check.sh
demo.code:
# Is this token a trap? ($0.03) A Base honeypot: block, the sell back reverts
bankr x402 call https://x402.bankr.bot/0x04a78f755d1cb5a5ea7c0a945d70ea51e562887f/token-safety-check -X POST -d '{"chain":"base","address":"0x67c958d79ea11830e145d3508103cfb2d5d7c620","amount_usd":50}'

# Is this address safe to pay? ($0.01) A sanctioned wallet: block
bankr x402 call https://x402.bankr.bot/0x04a78f755d1cb5a5ea7c0a945d70ea51e562887f/address-safety-check -X POST -d '{"chain":"base","address":"0x0330070FD38Ec3bB94F58FA55D40368271E9e54A"}'

# Or let the agent decide when to check
bankr prompt "Buy $50 of 0x67c958d79ea11830e145d3508103cfb2d5d7c620 on Base"

setup: No API key or account: each check is paid per call over x402 from your Bankr wallet ($0.03 a token, $0.01 an address, USDC on Base)
Keep a little USDC on Base in the wallet; you are charged only when an answer comes back
